newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Slovnaft oil seeks petrol price hike-paper.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Slovnaft oil seeks petrol price hike-paper.

text.p: Slovakia's sole oil refiner Slovnaft a.s. has proposed another increase in prices of its petrol fuels, effective October 1, due to growth of world prices of crude oil, the independent newspaper Pravda said on Thursday.
"Since world prices of crude oil continued to rise by an average of 10 percent in September, we have to react," the daily quoted Slovnaft Director Slavomir Hatina as saying.
The increase is expected to apply mainly to prices of diesel oil, which should increase by some 0.10 crowns per litre, and prices of 98-octane petrol, planned to rise by 0.40 crows per litre.
The increase must first be approved by the finance ministry.
Neither Slovnaft nor finance ministry officials were immediately available for comment.

On May 1, the finance ministry approved a request by Slovnaft to increase petrol fuel prices by about five percent, putting the maximum allowed price of petrol up 1.00 crown per litre and of diesel by 0.80 crowns per litre.
